Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (18)
Jin's appearance was changing.
His tail shone with energy, his hair had grown long enough to cover his shoulders, and in his pupils was the depth of a monarch who had ruled as an absolute being for ages.
Jin was becoming one with his godly self.
This was the result of Jin's ego sinking perfectly into the unconscious of his godly self.
Lingling could not take her eyes off the hole where Jin had disappeared in his inner world.
'Ban! No matter how I think about it, this is not right. If this continues, that fool's ego will soon be completely gone. So we have to finish this as quickly as possible!'
Ban nodded heavily.
Although it was a decision made in trust of Jin, it was undeniably a risky choice to continue with the Monarch's rule.
Therefore, just as Lingling said, they had to use all their strength and quickly finish off the evil spirit.
The roar, announcing that one person has become the king of light.
The intention to annihilate the enemy.
The sword, surpassing the limits of a mortal.
For example, one that can challenge a god.
The culminating energy becomes a pure white light above all else.
The energy that dyed the earth began to discolor and whirl white.
The swirling energy centered on Ban, was full of holy energy, absorbing 'order'.
Sound was the first to disappear into the sea of energy.

The roar resulting from the fusion of the evil spirit and Ram, the grotesque sound of black, huge flesh and machines intermingling, the screams of the evil spirit torn apart by the pain, the gasps and astonishments of the people watching all this, the sharp breaking sound caused by the storm of energy.
All were trapped in the sea of energy swirling around Ban.
Ban and the evil spirit, hundreds of fleets, and countless people were all moving, but the only one who could make or hear sound in it was the godly self.
Next, sight disappeared.
The intensely glowing energy was closing everyone's eyes.
Whether their eyes were closed or open, all they could see was suffocating white.
The vague figure floating in it was the afterimage of Ban.
Regardless of where they stood or which direction they looked, everyone saw the same scene.
Without exception, everyone saw the vague back figure of Ban.
They looked at a back that gave them the belief that it would protect them from anything.
On the other hand, the evil spirit saw Ban's face.
A face so fearsome that just facing it seemed to tear his whole body, and even the life he had lived up to now, to shreds, his fierce eyes were clawing at the evil spirit's soul.
Since the sound disappeared, he couldn't even scream.
The evil spirit just gaped like a fish.
Finally, time disappeared.
Everything caught in the divine aura was frozen.
Even allies like Quicantel and Enya, who were under the protection of Olta, could not escape its absolute interference.
'Olta, he's afraid...!'
Even these two felt the fear engulfing Olta. The god of time could not overcome the phenomenon derived from a mortal's sword.
Ban walked slowly in the frozen world.
In the whiteness, only the pale blade of Sigmund shone vaguely like a ghost.
And as Sigmund moved, the sea of divine aura roared in response.
When the sword pointed upwards, the sharp insides of the sea stretched out with it, and when the sword pointed down, all the surging divine aura sank at once.
It looked like a massive whale leaping from the water's surface.
Each time the whale crashed along the sword, a piece of Lam was torn apart.
Or it disappeared. The soul energy that made up Lam evaporated as soon as the divine aura touched it.
It was being completely extinguished, unable to return to either Lam or the monster.
Quiet slaughter.
Those who watched had to come up with such an odd description. The monster that had dyed the whole world in despair was being slaughtered in eerie silence.
Ban simply wielded his sword with a calm face.
Between the infinite graceful trajectories left by Sigmund, the monster's despair piled up.
'Am I, Rosa Runcandel... so insignificant...'
In the end, an uncontrollable sense of defeat rose in the monster's inner self.
There was nothing.
Nothing could be done. While being slashed by Sigmund, both in body and soul, it had almost finished merging with Lam.
Rosa Runcandel's ego had not been lost, and she had gained even stronger divine status.
But what was the use of it?
Even if she merged with Lam a thousand times, she couldn't defeat that beast.
Unless she became a perfect deity, placed at the very top among them, it was absolutely impossible to break Ban.
It drove her mad.
She couldn't accept it.
The fact that she was wrong, the fact that the power she had obtained at the cost of so much couldn't change this situation, the fact that it had to end like this.
It wasn't that she couldn't accept it. She had been aware from the start that there could be something with a greater power than her in the world.
What the monster truly couldn't accept was that this wasn't a fight with her youngest.
What she had faced with her entire life wasn't the leader of a great race that had disappeared half a millennium ago, but her own youngest child.
The divinity was ruining her fight now.
Whether defeated or victorious. The end of this fight had to be between her and her youngest.
If he was just lending his power, she could have accepted it. She too had embraced the power of chaos.
However, fighting a monster that had no part of her youngest left was a dreadful task.
She, too, had not completely abandoned her ego as Rosa Runcandel.
Around the time the monster was thinking this far.
Ban's mighty sword was pointing towards the middle.
Lam looked like a continental rift.
The hull, nearly 10 miles long, was completely shattered.
Like sea snow spewed out by the death of a massive marine creature, the flesh of Lam and the monster was thoroughly shattered and scattering into particles.
The monster could see a 'line' that looked like the light of salvation.
'What is...that line?'
A red line was visible behind Ban.
It was not visible until now, but the red line was naturally connected to Ban's body as if it had been there from the beginning.
Soon, an intuition pricked the inside of the monster.
'A connection point, just like when my youngest was dealing with Runtia!'
The line that harmonizes Jin and Ban.
The identity of the red line had to be that.
'Why didn't I think of it, if I cut that line... the divinity will no longer be able to stick to my youngest! The divinity was summoned in the first place because of that line as a medium...!'
It felt like her heart was pounding in her chest, which had disappeared without even a form.
Hope had been born.
The hope that Jin found every time in a desperate moment, the throbbing sensation when reaching out to grab it.
The monster was feeling it now.
The monster, being buried in despair, widened her soul's eyes.
If she could cut that line, if she just cuts it, she could fight her youngest again.
Her obsession was burning.
Then, fragments of the shattered Lam began to overcome the frozen time, little by little.
Although at a very minimal level, the fragments were moving.
Ban took this lightly.
After all, given the power of the monster, this level of resistance was expected, and he had figured out her plan.
[She intends to eliminate something connecting Jin and me......]
As if it was absurd, Ban did not even hide that he had read the monster's plan.
The monster couldn't hear Ban's voice.
Even if the sound disappeared, Ban's voice resonated accurately within everyone.
The reason the monster couldn't hear Ban's voice was that she was completely melting herself into one obsession.
The determination to cut the red line.
That determination soon became a form.
Suddenly, a sword formed in the void ten steps in front of Ban.
It was the beloved sword of Rosa Runcandel from her human days, Madness.
After Madness was formed, a hand to hold it was created, then a torso to swing the arm, black eyes that needed to look forward, and a face and head with horns of chaos.
The monster, once again in a form similar to a human, was laboriously walking in the void.
She was barely moving, aiming her sword at Ban.
[Does it seem possible?]
Ban erased her form with a single stroke.
When the lightning following Sigmund soared, Rosa was swept away, and there was no trace left in the void.
So the monster kept forming a body, and Ban ended it with a single blow each time.
The monster had formed a body dozens of times already, but the distance from Ban had not been shortened by even a single step.
On the contrary, every time the body was annihilated, it only became further away.
Even if there is hope, not everyone can grasp it on their own.
The disappearance of the monster's body meant that the fragments of Lam were being continuously consumed.
If time passed a little like this, in the end, there would not be a handful of the monster's spirits left on this land.
Ban raised his concentration. He had no intention of indulging in leisure while facing the monster to the very end.
However, when Sigmund had chopped the monster's body about a hundred times.
From the deepest part of Ban's inner world, a scream was heard.
Ling Ling.
And it was Jin's scream.
The 'one hour' predicted by Kwall had not even reached half.
'Argh… Ban, stop! It's really the limit! We need to stop the Divine Union now, to save Jin!'
The hole in the inner world where Jin disappeared was boiling.
Even Ling Ling was trapped inside and eroded.
Ling Ling was sure that stopping now was the last moment to save Jin's ego.
Eventually, Ban stopped the sword that was cutting the monster.
The monster, her body in tatters, ran towards Ban.
[You're lucky, monster.]
Ban didn't avoid the sword of the monster that had approached him close.
He just let the sword cut the red line, thinking.
'I have no choice but to leave the rest to the Jin brothers... and their friend.'
Through Jin's inner world, which Ban read the moment the Divine Union first took place.
He realized that he was not the first and last defeat.
'I leave Jin to you, Black Dragon Murakan.'
Madness cut off the red line.
